notes.title: Enjoy a brand-new look into Motel Simulator 👀
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, aspiring motel managers👫[/h1]

It’s been a while since the last time we shared some news regarding the development of Motel Simulator. But worry no more – today we’re finally able to unveil the brand-new trailer for the game – How cool is that? The trailer gives you a sneak peek into the latest features, gameplay enhancements, and what you can expect in the near future. So, let’s not waste any more time, and jump straight into the bustling world of Motel Simulator 🏨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993818/260d93b138e143e59e313687fa5176a1574250b3.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Trailer 📷[/h2]

The moment you’ve been waiting for is here! The new trailer for Motel Simulator is live now. It showcases the dynamic and immersive experience of managing your own roadside motel. From renovating rooms to handling bookings, ensuring guest satisfaction, and more! Combine those elements with a universe teeming with the different needs of your one-of-a-kind clientele, and you’ve got a unique mixture that you should not miss. Check it for yourself 👇

[previewyoutube=itI8hUmjn5w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What’s Next? 🤔 [/h2]

While the trailer is the main highlight, we’re also working on several new updates to enhance your gameplay experience. Our team is busy as popcorn on a skillet to bring you the best possible gameplay experience and we cannot wait to see your ideas and suggestions regarding our brand-new title. 

Thank you for your ongoing support and enthusiasm. We can’t wait for you to see all the exciting things we have in store. Head over to the Steam page to learn more about the Motel Simulator. Last but not least, if you want to stay up-to-date with any news regarding the game, make sure to add it to your wishlist🙇Until the next devlog!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1792100/Motel_Simulator/

[i]~Sewek[/i]

notes.title: Routastic event is coming! 🔥
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! 👋

We're thrilled to announce that we're preparing a Routastic Event that will be live on April 26th, 2023. The event will feature some huge discounts on our games. What is more, we'll be giving away some Steam keys to some of the games from our friendly developers, so make sure to mark those dates in calendars, folks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993818/a0e6987ed31dda04ede74ec4a501166978e408b2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Road Diner Simulator – New Cinematic Teaser🍔[/h2]

We've been eagerly waiting to share this news with you! We've managed to prepare a new cinematic teaser for Road Diner Simulator, and for those of you who have already played Gas Station Simulator, we guarantee you gonna see some familiar faces there! We cannot wait to share more information regarding Road Diner Simulator in the future. But enough talking – grab your favorite drink & snack, and simply enjoy watching the trailer below⬇️

[previewyoutube=mRYF3urUYcU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Stay up-to-date📰[/h2]

And we've come to an end! We cannot wait to share more information regarding the event, Road Diner Simulator, and American Airport Simulator. While you eagerly waiting for all of this suff, you can check our other titles. For instance, Airstrip DLC is releasing just in two weeks, so if you don't want to miss it, consider adding it to your wishlist, so you'll be notified as soon as the game releases.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137370/Gas_Station_Simulator__Airstrip_DLC/
